_help: The delivery and offer facts the site shows, in one place. Prices and MRPs stay in catalog.json.

Change a number here and these follow: the blue top bar on every page, the delivery lines on product pages, the cart, the Shipping & Returns page, and what the server charges (Demo Kit delivery, wallet).
Days are business days. workingDays are the days the courier works; add courier holidays as "YYYY-MM-DD".
Top bar: lines rotate in this order, one every secondsPerLine. A line is skipped when it cannot be true today (see the line keys below).

Line keys: text (words; {tokens} are filled in), link (optional), needs ("cod" / "no-cod": shown only while cashOnDelivery is on / off; "voice": only where Saathi is on the page), before ("YYYY-MM-DD": shown only while an order placed today still arrives before that date), from / until ("YYYY-MM-DD": shown only from / up to and including that day, India time), show (false hides it).

products: what each product page says about itself. hook is the one-line opener, points are the ticked lines (lead in bold, then the rest), cartridgeMonths adds a cost-per-month line (12 months and up) or a cost-per-day line, worked out from the catalog price. The Demo Kit's page is product.js markPageKit.
Saathi (the voice assistant) says these numbers in her own words in server/assistant.js and js/voice-assistant.js: change them there too.
